The sky grows closer, descending upon the horizon like a great weight. A crushing force presses down on you, sending a tremor through your muscles, compelling you to clamp your mouth shut. Your teeth meet with a sickening click, and a shudder runs through you. The tightening of your jaw - it is the sealing of something, a locking in place. You try to loosen your grip, but your jaw resists. {great_one} has taken control.

There is a rising pressure behind your teeth, and with it, an unmistakable taste: the metallic tang of blood. It begins as a trickle, then a sudden rush, pooling in your mouth, filling it. You try to expel it, to gasp for air, but your jaw is locked tight and the blood swells in your mouth with a sickening, suffocating force - as though it is not just spilling from your body but rising from the depths of your soul.

A thick, viscous liquid gurgles against your tongue, coating the insides of your cheeks, seeping into the very back of your throat. You try to swallow, but it does no good - it is too much, an alien substance that was never meant to be a part of you. It is too thick, too alive, like a choking tide pressing against your gums. It has weight. It moves wrong. It clings to your tongue, as though it has a will of its own.

You are the unwilling vessel, and the blood is the key - a dark river that flows not from your wounds, but from some deeper source. You are no longer merely a body. You are an instrument, a conduit for the unrelenting will of {great_one}.

A harsh energy radiates from the sky, as though the heavens themselves are alive and breathing cold air, each exhalation distorting the atmosphere - an insidious creeping that begins as a mere chill, almost imperceptible.

{great_one}, a massive, impossible form, appears beyond the sky. A vast being emanating a cold that feels unnatural, as though it has come from a place where time itself has frozen in eternal stasis. As the cold spreads, it feels as if the very substance of your body is losing its connection to the warmth of life.

Your skin feels thin, like a fragile membrane stretched too tight over your bones. The warmth inside you is being siphoned away, and with it, your sense of self. Your lungs, frozen by the encroaching cold, begin to rebel, shuddering in protest as you draw in frigid air that tastes of something older than time, a flavor born from decay.

Each beat of your heart is like the final tick of a dying clock, each thump slower than the last, as though time itself is freezing inside you. The warmth of your body pulls back, leaving only a hollow, frozen shell that is less human than it was moments ago. The chill penetrates even deeper, working its way into your mind, freezing your thoughts, slowing them, making them sluggish and foreign.

Your memories begin to fracture, to splinter, as though your very identity is being carved away. It is as if you are slipping out of yourself, sliding into something other - something vast and unreachable, that does not know warmth or life. Your thoughts grow distant. You are becoming a part of the void, of the endless, frozen cosmos, where there is no warmth, no life - only a vast, uncaring nothingness.

A strange stillness begins to settle over you - an unearthly calm that hangs heavy in the air. It is as if time itself has fractured, each second stretching into eternity, while the world around you grows distant, fading into a hazy red blur. A numb, oppressive sensation drifts over your skin - the touch of {great_one}. Around you, the world begins to distort, warping into shapes that are not quite solid. Something monstrous is pressing against the fabric of reality.

Suddenly, there is a harsh, violent tear that rends the air with a brutal, tearing scream. Then, a sense of absence. A yawning chasm opens within you, pulling at the edges of your consciousness. It is the absence of self, a disintegration of identity. You are no longer bound by the familiar contours of your body, as if your soul has begun to unravel. The world begins to recede, as though you are falling backward through endless corridors of nothingness.
Reality is peeling away, layer by layer, until there is no you, no world, no existence at all. There is no escape. You are dissolving. You are being erased.

And then, just as you feel the final fragment of your consciousness slipping away into the abyss, there is a violent burst - a surge of reality, of air, of light, of sound. Your senses return, gasping. But it is not the same world.

You feel the weight of the experience - like an unwelcome presence still lingering just beyond the veil of your mind, a presence that is aware of you. Something from beyond the threshold of death has touched you, and the world now feels darker, infinitely more vast. You are no longer certain whether you are still within your own body.

The sky twists into a deep, blood-red expanse, the color of a dying sun, as a massive figure begins to take shape in its depths. The size of {great_one} is beyond reckoning. You cannot see its limits; the sky itself has become its body, its tendrils reaching through the very cosmos, stretching its presence toward you. You feel them slithering around you.

There is no warning - just the swift, disturbing sensation of something invasive pushing into you. You feel the tendrils as they pierce your flesh with a slow, sinewy penetration - a feeling of unholy intrusion. A strange, suction-like pull as they embed themselves into your body, burrowing with unnatural precision.

You feel as though your bones are being tapped into. The tendrils seem to pulse with a life of their own. You realize that they are consuming, slowly drawing away something precious. You can feel it now: the bones shifting under the pressure, the bone marrow being drawn from its sanctum like a warm, liquid essence. They pull with a rhythmic, unnatural force, not allowing you the mercy of fainting or escape.

The air grows thicker still, and the pressure within your bones intensifies. You feel the last pull that drains away the final essence of you, leaving behind only a hollow, aching shell. The tendrils retract, slithering back into the unseen recesses from whence they came, leaving behind only a suffocating emptiness.

The world around you seems to shudder. {great_one} touched you, violated your soul and claimed that which made you whole. You are no longer yourself, but a hollowed vessel, marked forever by the void's embrace.

As the sky bleeds into a deep, unsettling crimson, {great_one} begins to manifest above. An emptiness spreads from deep within the core of your body, an unsettling lightness. The feeling grows - an insidious void that consumes you from the inside out. Something vital has begun to slowly drain away, and you are helpless to stop it.

Then you feel something burst inside you, violently opening a space that should not exist within the human form. Your blood flows away in unrelenting currents, vanishing into the unseen, leaving a gnawing emptiness that spreads through your veins. The warmth of life seeps out of you, leaving a coldness that seems to claw at the edges of your bones. The world around you grows faint, distant, slipping from your grasp, slipping into the void. You remain still, surrendering to the pull of nothingness.

The world shifts, flickering like a dying light, as though it too is beginning to fade. Your body, now an empty shell, seems to lose all connection to the world, all tether to life. Your essence, your blood, is being summoned to some cosmic well where the life force of all things is drawn to feed an unknowable hunger. You are dissolving, becoming nothing, as though you were never meant to exist at all.

A sudden quiet settles over you, as if the world has stopped and is holding its breath. You can feel the air shift, and for the briefest of moments, the world becomes wrong. You are standing right on the edge of reality, below you an infinite expanse of darkness, above you the red sky. You hear the slow, rhythmic beat of some vast, unknowable force. {great_one} emerges.

Something beyond your understanding is creeping into your head - a strange buzzing, a vibration deep within your skull. It is not a mere headache, but a presence, something alien, stirring beneath the surface, slithering, then writhing in distress. The buzzing grows louder, more insistent; it becomes a pulse that you cannot control, as if your body and mind are suddenly attuned to some strange, incomprehensible rhythm.

The world fractures. Your vision goes black. There is a crushing, suffocating flood of sensation. You feel the terrible consciousness of {great_one}. Your body is no longer yours, but a puppet its grasp. Every muscle, every sinew is stretched, pulled, contorted in ways that should not be possible.

Your soul is being drawn into a vortex, spiraling into an abyss where there is no return. Each second expands into eternity, then compresses into nothing, as you are lost in the eternal loop of this madness - unable to escape, unable to understand.

And then the storm subsides. The void recedes. The terrible presence that has filled you is gone. You realize that this was only a glimpse, a fleeting touch of something far older, far more terrible than anything you could ever comprehend.

The sky is an unnatural red, a molten horizon that seems to burn from within. From this crimson void, something unimaginable stirs - {great_one}. An unsettling warmth creeps beneath your skin. It grows, expanding from a distant spark into a sharp burning. It spreads quickly, like the tendrils of a monstrous vine wrapping around your limbs. Heat sears through the surface of your body like a thousand unseen needles, something that burns not just your flesh, but your very soul.

The pain floods every nerve, turning them into raw, exposed conduits of agony. You cannot scream, for your mouth is dry, your tongue stiff with the heat, your body trembling with feverish intensity. Your skin feels as if it is melting. Your body is being devoured by an infernal hunger, an insatiable maw of fire that consumes everything it touches - something unyielding, that eats away at you slowly.

{great_one} watches with cold, unfeeling eyes as you are consumed. It seeks to devour not just your flesh, but the very essence of who you are. It rips through you with cruel, inexorable force. The flames curl and twist; the agony becomes an otherworldly thing. The boundaries of your own body slip away, the burning consuming more than just your skin. It begins to devour your very being. You are being reduced to nothingness, piece by piece, until there is only the fire.
You are nothing more than ash, cast into the void - the last remnants of your existence lost to an inferno that never truly ends.

A deep hum vibrates through the atmosphere, low and resonant, like the sound of a distant gong reverberating through the ground. The sky begins to throb in time with the hum, a pulse that seems to come from everywhere at once. The sky shudders, convulsing into a violent red, as though a wound has opened in the heavens. {great_one} is spilling its awareness into the world below.

Fingers press into your skull, unyielding. An insidious pressure spreads like a wave, starting at the base of your skull, creeping upward, reaching into the very folds of your brain. Pain begins to bloom. It is a vast, consuming thing that centers in your head and spreads outward in waves.

Each throb pulses like the slow beating of a monstrous heart, reverberating through your skull in jagged rhythms. You hear a screaming tidal wave of unbearable noise. The hum of the world around you rises to a maddening crescendo. {great_one} is burrowing deep within you. It seeks to drag your soul from the prison of your body. A sensation of exposure, a rawness that goes beyond the physical.

Each moment drags on like an eternity. Then the weight that has crushed your skull begins to loosen its grip, slowly. The pain gradually softens, the swelling of your head receding, leaving behind only the lingering aftertaste of agony. You wonder if the pain has truly passed, or if it is merely lying dormant, waiting for the right moment to return.

Your vision distorts, blurring into a red haze of unreal shapes. The world itself begins to twist, sounds are distant echoes, and the space around you seems to collapse and stretch in unnatural ways. Your eyes burn, as though your sight is being torn from you. Suddenly, an overwhelming alien presence inhabits your body. A crushing weight seems to descend upon your head, an oppressive force of unseen presence - {great_one}.

The headache comes as a sudden explosion - a thunderclap within your skull - and in that moment, it feels as though your mind is fracturing. At once, your body becomes a strange thing. Your limbs, once familiar and controlled, now seem alien to you - foreign appendages, no longer answering to your will.

You feel as if your arms are being slowly drained of life, growing heavy. Your skin feels as though it is rotting from within, stretching and slackening unnaturally. Your face warps, drawn into grotesque asymmetry - the left side slipping away into a cold, unreachable space, while the right side sears with an infernal heat.

A chill terror rises in your chest as you understand, on some deep level, that {great_one} feeds on the unraveling of your mind. It presses against your senses, driving your mind into a state of dread. You are left suspended in a vast, unfeeling ocean, helpless before the colossal force that has suddenly woken inside you. You are no longer in control.

The familiar sky is gone, replaced by an oppressive, blood-tinged void that stretches endlessly. The sensation begins subtly, like the whisper of something malevolent in the depths of your body - a creeping unease deep within your chest, as {great_one} takes root in the very core of your being.

At first, it is merely a tightening, a faint constriction. Then your heart is gripped by some unseen hand. Soon, that hand's fingers curl with cruel intent. A deep, gnawing sensation spreads through your chest like a creeping shadow, filling every corner of your consciousness with a sickening dread.

There is no longer any comfort in the steady pulse of life, only a dreadful awareness that something is breaking down within you. The breath you draw is shallow; each inhalation carries with it the scent of cold decay and rot. Each gasp becomes an effort of survival, a desperate struggle. The world around you begins to fade. The edges of your vision blur as you teeter on the edge of oblivion, and the terror grows.

With dreadful certainty, you realize that your heart has become a vessel for {great_one}. The pulse of your life fades, not into death, but into the void. And then, you surrender. You are no longer a separate being, but a part of something incomprehensible. You have become a single beat in a rhythm that transcends you - a rhythm that will never cease.

The Grimoire is a powerful artefact bestowed upon you by the Deep Ones.
With it, you can cast magic and also observe the villagers' actions, relationships, and emotions..

The Deep Ones appointed you as the leader of a cult that worships their gods.
To join the cult, a villager must first prove their faith by marrying a Deep One. Once married, they can be recruited and must swear an oath to serve the Deep Ones and bear or sire their children.

Your small seaside fishing village had been struggling with a dire economic situation.
However, after forging a pact with the Deep Ones, the village's fortunes have drastically improved.

The village comprises five families and several households.
Family Chiefs and Household Heads hold significant influence over their members' opinions and enjoy high social status.

Magus is the highest rank in the cult, surpassing priest, apprentice, and novice.

The Grimoire is a powerful artefact bestowed upon you by the Deep Ones.

It grants you the ability to oversee all villagers, including their actions, relationships, and emotions.

With the Grimoire, you can study documents, learn sigils, mark households, create spells, and cast them.

Click the 'Plus' symbol to create a new spell.
Click on unstudied documents to learn new sigils.

Click the 'Plus' symbol to create a new spell.

Click on a spell to access options for renaming or deleting it.

To cast spells, use the action menu on the left side of the screen. (The Spellbook must be closed).

To break a spell, move your cursor over the spell icon of the selected person in the bottom left of the screen, and click the 'Break Spell' button that appears. (The Spellbook must be closed).

Erasing a spell will also remove its effects from all individuals it was affecting.

To remove a spell's effects from a specific person, you only need to break the spell. Move your cursor over the spell icon of the selected person in the bottom left of the screen, and click the 'Break Spell' button that appears. (The Spellbook must be closed).

Sigils are essential for creating spells and marking households.
You can learn sigils by studying documents; click on an unstudied document to examine it. To combine sigils and create a new spell, click the 'Plus' symbol in the 'Spells' section.

To mark a household, first close the grimoire and select the desired household. Then click on the sigil button. Choose a sigil from the list to apply it. The mark will remain in effect until the end of the day/year, affecting the behavior of the household's inhabitants.

Marking a household with a sigil will influence the behavior of its inhabitants. They will be more inclined to favour the action that is aligned with the intent represented by the sigil.

Click on the sigil button. Then choose a sigil from the list to apply it. The mark will remain in effect until the end of the day/year.

5-9 years: Apprentice
10+ years: Priest
